newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Switzerland abandons road project in Madagascar.
newsitem.headline: Switzerland abandons road project in Madagascar.

text.p: The Swiss government said on Friday it was abandoning a major road project in Madagascar as authorities had failed to make any progress in investigating the murder last July of the Swiss national in charge of the work.
The Swiss embassy in a statement said the road improvement project was being halted as basic conditions for it to continue had not been met since the killing of Arnold Walter.

The embassy said it regretted the consequences on the population of stopping work on the largest Swiss project on the island, which had cost 50 million Swiss francs since 1986. It said other Swiss aid projects would continue.
